The '''63rd [[Writers Guild of America Award]]s''' honored the best [[film writer|film]], [[television writer|television]], and [[Television writer#Video game writing|videogame writers]] of 2010. Winners were announced on February 5, 2011.<ref name="Date">{{cite web|url= http://www.wga.org/awards/awardssub.aspx?id=1516 |title= 2011 NOMINATIONS |publisher=[[Writers Guild of America]]|access-date= February 19, 2011 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20110219130718/http://www.wga.org/awards/awardssub.aspx?id=1516 |archive-date= February 19, 2011 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2012-2006 |title=Writers Guild Awards Winners: 2012-2006 |work=wga.org |publisher=Writers Guild of America |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251228141617/https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2012-2006 |archive-date=2025-12-28 |access-date=2026-02-20 |url-status=live }}</ref>
